title: FDA Modernization Act 3.0

claims.claim: Section 3209(a) of the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2023 (Public Law 117-328) amended Section 505(i) of the FFDCA (21 U.S.C. 355).
claims.sourceSpan: the amendments to section 505(i) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (21 U.S.C. 355(i)) made by section 3209(a) of the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2023 (Public Law 117-328; 136 Stat. 5821)

claims.claim: The 2023 change replaced "preclinical tests (including tests on animals)" with "nonclinical tests".
claims.sourceSpan: preclinical tests (including tests on animals)

claims.claim: Section 3209(a) added a statutory definition of "nonclinical test".
claims.sourceSpan: added subsec. (z) defining nonclinical test

claims.claim: Definition: a test conducted in vitro, in silico, or in chemico, or a nonhuman in vivo test, occurring before or during clinical trials.
claims.sourceSpan: a test conducted in vitro, in silico, or in chemico, or a nonhuman in vivo test, that occurs before or during the clinical trial phase of the investigation of the safety and effectiveness of a drug

claims.claim: The rule must amend "any other section necessary to ensure regulatory consistency with the amendments to section 505(i)... made by section 3209(a) of the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2023".

claims.sourceSpan: Any other section necessary to ensure regulatory consistency

claims.claim: The bill sets a 1-year deadline for the interim final rule but does not require FDA to issue a subsequent final rule following ordinary notice-and-comment.
claims.sourceSpan: not later than 1 year after the date of enactment of this Act
claims.note: Deadline sourced; absence of any subsequent-final-rule requirement verified across the full bill.

claims.claim: The bill does not address whether biologics-specific regulations at 21 CFR Part 600 (beyond 601.31 and 601.35(d)) or animal-drug regulations should be similarly updated.
claims.sourceSpan: Section 601.35(d)
claims.note: Valid scope-gap; "Part 600" is loose — 601.31/601.35 are in Part 601, not Part 600.

claims.claim: The bill does not address the parallel FFDCA Section 351 (biologics licensing), which references similar preclinical/animal terminology.
claims.note: Section 351 appears in neither source; biologics licensing is PHS Act §351 (42 U.S.C. 262), not FFDCA §351 — likely a conflation. Extrinsic to fetched source; peripheral gap note.

claims.claim: The bill adds the definition to four CFR sections but does not require FDA to develop guidance on which nonclinical methods are appropriate for which drug categories.
claims.sourceSpan: to sections 312.3, 314.3, 315.2, and 601.31 of title 21, Code of Federal Regulations
claims.note: Four sections sourced; absence of a guidance-development requirement verified.

L. 117-328 amendment notes (§3209(a)(2) added the definition; §3601(a) added the diversity plan). All 21 listed CFR sections (A)-(U), the (V) catch-all, the 1-year deadline, the 5 U.S.C. 553(b)(B) good-cause waiver, and the (z)->(aa) technical amendment verified against source. featured_quotes (a Congressional Record floor quote) is out of scope for this source-only pass — it is not contained in the bill text or referencedSources.
